final:
Implemented atomic ledger batches by staging balances and committed IDs, so any failed transfer leaves ledger state unchanged. Replays are skipped both across batches and within a batch; conflicting IDs reject. Transfer validation now checks string account IDs and safe integer cents, and handles special account keys safely.
